note: Prototype Screen 06 Appearance Detail catalogs (Identification / Livery / Surface Finish). Not STA 2E published hull-marking tables (Core p. 194 covers name/registry only). gameplay: cosmetic | contextual | earned. Earned options require Screen 04 / Official Service History selections. linksTraitSource means the marking visualizes an existing Trait and must not grant a second Trait. Weathering is visual only and does not change Structure or damage state.

options.name: Visible Registry
options.caption: Clear Starfleet registry lettering on the hull.
options.description: Displays standard, readable registry typography. Contextual recognition: other ships and stations can identify the vessel by registry when circumstances allow. Does not change Systems or Departments.

options.name: Minimal Registry
options.caption: Recessed, low-contrast registry markings.
options.description: Uses subdued registry placement for a cleaner silhouette. Cosmetic only.

options.name: Altered Registry
options.caption: Hard-to-read or deliberately altered identification.
options.description: Registry markings are obscured, incomplete, or altered. Contextual: may invite suspicion during security or inspection encounters. Does not change Systems or Departments.

options.name: Standard Hull ID
options.caption: Standard Starfleet hull identification graphics.
options.description: Applies conventional Federation hull identification markings. Cosmetic presentation only; does not grant Traits.

options.name: Federation Pennant
options.caption: Federation pennant markings on the hull.
options.description: Displays Federation pennant graphics. Contextual recognition during diplomatic or Starfleet encounters when circumstances support it. Does not change Systems or Departments.

options.name: Medical Mission Markings
options.caption: Exterior markings signaling medical or relief duty.
options.description: Shows medical/relief mission identification. Earned from Hope Ship service, rescue/evacuation events, or a Humanitarian citation. Contextual recognition on appropriate missions. Does not invent an honor or change Systems.

options.name: Diplomatic Mission Markings
options.caption: Exterior markings signaling diplomatic assignment.
options.description: Shows diplomatic mission identification. Earned from diplomatic reputation, breakthrough events, or Diplomatic Excellence citation. Contextual recognition when an authorized diplomatic assignment applies. Does not invent an honor.

options.name: Commendation Insignia
options.caption: Displays the Starfleet Commendation on the hull.
options.description: Visual presentation of an already-earned Starfleet Commendation. Requires that honor on Screen 04. Does not grant a second Trait.

options.name: Humanitarian Citation Insignia
options.caption: Displays the Humanitarian Service Citation.
options.description: Visual presentation of an already-earned Humanitarian Service Citation. Requires that honor on Screen 04. Does not grant a second Trait.

options.name: Diplomatic Citation Insignia
options.caption: Displays the Diplomatic Excellence Citation.
options.description: Visual presentation of an already-earned Diplomatic Excellence Citation. Requires that honor on Screen 04. Does not grant a second Trait.

options.name: Exploration Citation Insignia
options.caption: Displays the Distinguished Exploration Citation.
options.description: Visual presentation of an already-earned Distinguished Exploration Citation. Requires that honor on Screen 04. Does not grant a second Trait.

options.name: Defense Citation Insignia
options.caption: Displays the Defense of the Federation Citation.
options.description: Visual presentation of an already-earned Defense of the Federation Citation. Requires that honor on Screen 04. Does not grant a second Trait.

options.name: Classic Red Striping
options.caption: Traditional red accent striping.
options.description: Applies classic red accent striping along primary hull lines. Distinct from the legacy Striping Style field. Cosmetic only.

options.name: Aztec Panel Pattern
options.caption: Aztec-style panel contrast pattern.
options.description: Emphasizes TMP-and-later panel patterning on the hull. Cosmetic only. Available from the Motion Picture era onward.

options.name: Standard Nacelle Marks
options.caption: Standard nacelle identification markings.
options.description: Default nacelle markings for the class silhouette. Cosmetic only.

options.name: High-Visibility Nacelle Marks
options.caption: Higher-contrast nacelle warning markings.
options.description: Increases contrast on nacelle tip and pylon markings. Cosmetic only; does not change Engines.

options.name: Standard Engineering Hull
options.caption: Standard secondary-hull marking treatment.
options.description: Conventional engineering-hull graphics. Cosmetic only.

options.name: Yard Pattern
options.caption: Shipyard-style engineering-hull markings.
options.description: Emphasizes construction-yard style markings on the secondary hull. Cosmetic only.

options.name: Starfleet Grey
options.caption: Standard Starfleet hull grey.
options.description: Familiar fleet grey hull coloration. Cosmetic only.

options.name: Muted Wartime
options.caption: Subdued wartime hull coloration.
options.description: Mutes accent brightness for a wartime presentation. Cosmetic only; does not change armor or shields.

options.name: Clean Finish
options.caption: Fresh, well-maintained hull finish.
options.description: A clean, well-kept exterior finish. Cosmetic only.

options.name: Matte Finish
options.caption: Low-sheen matte hull finish.
options.description: Reduces hull sheen for a matte presentation. Cosmetic only.

options.name: Low Panel Contrast
options.caption: Subtle panel line contrast.
options.description: Softens panel line contrast across the hull. Cosmetic only.

options.name: High Panel Contrast
options.caption: Strong panel line contrast.
options.description: Increases panel line contrast for a sharper exterior read. Cosmetic only.

options.name: No Weathering
options.caption: No visible weathering or scarring.
options.description: Hull appears freshly maintained. Cosmetic only. Does not change damage state.

options.name: Light Weathering
options.caption: Light wear and surface weathering.
options.description: Shows light wear. Contextual: NPCs may remark on the ship's apparent condition. Visual only — does not alter Structure, Resistance, or damage state.

options.name: Battle-Scarred
options.caption: Visible battle scarring on the hull.
options.description: Shows battle scarring. Earned from Survivor of X or border-incident / major-systems-failure events. Visual only — does not change Structure or invent damage Traits.
